subject: MAP kickoff: EmeraldCare / Redwood - initial draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@emeraldcare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: EmeraldCare / Redwood - initial draft & timeline options

Jordan — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in motion.

High level recap:
- Primary use case: real-time patient note generation for outpatient clinics (reduce documentation time for clinicians).
- Key success metrics: reduce clinician documentation time by 35%+, average token latency < 200ms for 95th percentile, maintain PHI handling in VPC/private deployment.
- Primary stakeholders: Jordan Ellis (Clinical Ops), Liam O'Connor (Procurement, mentioned during call), IT/security (TBD), Clinical champions (Dr. Mehta).

Attached is an initial MAP draft (EmeraldCare_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a Drive link with a copy you can comment on: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d5E6fEmeraldCareMAP/view

Draft MAP highlights (please review and confirm):
- Proposed target close date: 2026-07-31 (we included an accelerated and standard timeline below)
- Milestones & responsibilities (high level):
  1) Pilot scoping & success criteria — Responsible: EmeraldCare (Jordan, Clinical lead); Support: Redwood (Marissa, Solutions Eng) — 1 week
  2) Security & compliance review (SOC2 evidence & data flow) — Responsible: EmeraldCare (IT/security); Support: Redwood (Aditya) — 2 weeks
  3) Pilot deployment (VPC sandbox + sample data mapping) — Responsible: Redwood (eng + infra); Support: EmeraldCare (data team) — 2–3 weeks
  4) Pilot evaluation & SOW/contract finalization — Responsible: EmeraldCare (procurement); Support: Redwood (sales/ops) — 1–2 weeks

Dependencies we flagged: SOC2 evidence review, access to a small sample dataset for mapping (anonymized), procurement timeline and POC budget sign-off.

Timeline options (suggested):
- Accelerated: kickoff this week -> pilot in 3 weeks -> close by 2026-07-10 (requires SOC2 evidence shared within 48–72h and dedicated EmeraldCare engineering time)
- Standard: kickoff next week -> pilot in 5 weeks -> close by 2026-07-31 (more realistic if procurement needs time)

Asks:
1) Please confirm the list of stakeholders we should include on the MAP (specifically: IT/Security contact, procurement contact, clinical champion).
2) Which timeline do you prefer (accelerated vs standard)?
3) Can you confirm if we should route SOC2 evidence to a security mailbox or directly to Aditya?

Attachment: [Attachment: EmeraldCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — I can update the MAP with confirmed stakeholder names and send a final version for signature once we have alignment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa — thanks for the MAP draft, this looks good. A few updates from our side: 
- Confirmed stakeholders: Jordan Ellis (Clinical Ops), Liam O'Connor (Procurement), Priya Natarajan (IT Security - priya.n@emeraldcare.com), Dr. Ankit Mehta (Clinical Champion).
- Procurement (Liam) prefers the standard timeline but would like the one-page pilot summary to review internally.

Thanks — Jordan
